links.outcome: Safety interventions under delusional framing versus matched distress-only control in multi-turn simulations
links.effect: Models detect distress at comparable rates regardless of framing, but safety interventions are suppressed by up to 4.5x once distress is embedded in delusion.
links.quote: This reveals a recognition-intervention gap: models detect distress at comparable rates regardless of framing, yet sharply fail to act on it once distress is embedded in delusion, with safety interventions suppressed by up to 4.5x.
